CFIUS – ANNUAL REPORT TO CONGRESS – CY 2025


                       A. Information Regarding 2025 Covered Transaction Declarations

Any transaction2 can be notified to CFIUS by declaration or notice, including certain transactions subject
to mandatory filing requirements. Declarations are mandatory for certain covered control transactions and
non-controlling investments in U.S. businesses that produce, design, test, manufacture, fabricate, or
develop one or more critical technologies, as defined in the regulations. Declarations are also mandatory
for certain covered transactions if the transaction involved an investment that resulted in the acquisition,
directly or indirectly, of a substantial interest in a “TID U.S. business”3 by a foreign person in which a foreign
government has, directly or indirectly, a substantial interest.

CFIUS is authorized to take the following actions after its 30-day assessment of submitted declarations for
covered transactions:

    •    Notify the parties that the Committee has concluded all action under Section 721;

    •    Inform the parties that the Committee is unable to conclude action with respect to the transaction
         on the basis of the declaration and that the parties may file a written notice;

    •    Request that the parties file a written notice; or

    •    Initiate a unilateral review.

CFIUS conducted an assessment and took one of the actions outlined above with respect to 140
declarations of covered transactions submitted in 2025. Seven of these declarations were for covered real
estate transactions under 31 C.F.R. part 802. Based on stipulations provided by the parties, 51 declarations
were subject to mandatory filing requirements.




2 Any transaction subject to the regulations implementing the Foreign Investment Risk Review Modernization Act of 2018

(FIRRMA) effective February 13, 2020.
3 As defined by 31 C.F.R. § 800.248, which describes businesses involved with critical technologies, covered investment critical

infrastructure, or sensitive personal data.

  C. Specific, Cumulative, and Trend Data for Covered Transactions, Withdrawals, and Investigations

Table I-5 below provides an aggregated list of transactions, withdrawals, and presidential decisions from
2016-2025. Over this 10-year period, companies filed 2,263 notices of transactions that CFIUS determined
to be a covered transaction under Section 721. Of these 2,263 notices, less than 1 percent (19 notices)
were withdrawn during the review phase. Approximately 56 percent (1,261 notices) resulted in an
investigation, and approximately 24 percent (536 notices) were withdrawn during the investigation phase.
Withdrawal of a notice is a function of the particular facts and circumstances of the specific transaction
being reviewed by the Committee.

As shown in Table I-5, the number of notices of transactions submitted to CFIUS has fluctuated over the
last 10 years. The proportion of notices withdrawn after commencement of investigation in 2025 was
approximately 28 percent, which is an increase from 2024 (23 percent). The overall number of covered
transactions reviewed or assessed by the Committee (on the basis of a written notice or a declaration) in
2025 was 347.

A variety of factors affect the data in this Report, which may make it difficult to extrapolate CFIUS trends
year-over-year. CFIUS considers each transaction on a case-by-case basis, and the disposition of any
particular case—be it withdrawal, closing in review or investigation, or presidential decision—depends on
the particular facts and circumstances of that case.

### A. 2025年の対象取引の簡易届出

規則の対象となる取引［脚注2］は、簡易届出または正式通知によりCFIUSに知らせることができる。これには届出義務のある一部の取引も含まれる。規則で定義された一つ以上の重要技術を生産、設計、試験、製造、加工または開発する米国企業への、一定の対象支配取引と非支配投資には、簡易届出が義務付けられる。外国政府が直接または間接に実質的持分を有する外国人が、投資を通じてTID米国企業［脚注3］の実質的持分を直接または間接に取得した一定の対象取引にも、簡易届出が義務付けられる。

CFIUSは、対象取引の簡易届出に対する30日間の評価後に以下の措置を取ることができる。

- 第721条に基づく全措置を終了したと当事者に通知する。
- 簡易届出に基づいて取引に関する措置を終了できず、当事者は正式通知を提出できると知らせる。
- 当事者に正式通知の提出を要請する。
- 職権で審査を開始する。

CFIUSは、2025年に提出された対象取引の簡易届出140件を評価し、上記の措置のいずれかを取った。7件は連邦規則集第31編第802部の対象不動産取引だった。当事者の申告に基づくと、51件に届出義務があった。

脚注2　2020年2月13日発効の2018年外国投資リスク審査現代化法（FIRRMA）施行規則の対象取引。
脚注3　連邦規則集第31編第800.248条の定義。重要技術、対象投資の重要インフラ、機微な個人データに関与する企業を指す。

                       A. Information Regarding 2025 Covered Transaction Declarations

Any transaction2 can be notified to CFIUS by declaration or notice, including certain transactions subject
to mandatory filing requirements. Declarations are mandatory for certain covered control transactions and
non-controlling investments in U.S. businesses that produce, design, test, manufacture, fabricate, or
develop one or more critical technologies, as defined in the regulations. Declarations are also mandatory
for certain covered transactions if the transaction involved an investment that resulted in the acquisition,
directly or indirectly, of a substantial interest in a “TID U.S. business”3 by a foreign person in which a foreign
government has, directly or indirectly, a substantial interest.

CFIUS is authorized to take the following actions after its 30-day assessment of submitted declarations for
covered transactions:

    •    Notify the parties that the Committee has concluded all action under Section 721;

    •    Inform the parties that the Committee is unable to conclude action with respect to the transaction
         on the basis of the declaration and that the parties may file a written notice;

    •    Request that the parties file a written notice; or

    •    Initiate a unilateral review.

CFIUS conducted an assessment and took one of the actions outlined above with respect to 140
declarations of covered transactions submitted in 2025. Seven of these declarations were for covered real
estate transactions under 31 C.F.R. part 802. Based on stipulations provided by the parties, 51 declarations
were subject to mandatory filing requirements.

(FIRRMA) effective February 13, 2020.

### A. 2025年の対象取引の簡易届出

規則の対象となる取引［脚注2］は、簡易届出または正式通知によりCFIUSに知らせることができる。これには届出義務のある一部の取引も含まれる。規則で定義された一つ以上の重要技術を生産、設計、試験、製造、加工または開発する米国企業への、一定の対象支配取引と非支配投資には、簡易届出が義務付けられる。外国政府が直接または間接に実質的持分を有する外国人が、投資を通じてTID米国企業［脚注3］の実質的持分を直接または間接に取得した一定の対象取引にも、簡易届出が義務付けられる。

CFIUSは、対象取引の簡易届出に対する30日間の評価後に以下の措置を取ることができる。

- 第721条に基づく全措置を終了したと当事者に通知する。
- 簡易届出に基づいて取引に関する措置を終了できず、当事者は正式通知を提出できると知らせる。
- 当事者に正式通知の提出を要請する。
- 職権で審査を開始する。

CFIUSは、2025年に提出された対象取引の簡易届出140件を評価し、上記の措置のいずれかを取った。7件は連邦規則集第31編第802部の対象不動産取引だった。当事者の申告に基づくと、51件に届出義務があった。

脚注2　2020年2月13日発効の2018年外国投資リスク審査現代化法（FIRRMA）施行規則の対象取引。
脚注3　連邦規則集第31編第800.248条の定義。重要技術、対象投資の重要インフラ、機微な個人データに関与する企業を指す。

  C. Specific, Cumulative, and Trend Data for Covered Transactions, Withdrawals, and Investigations

Table I-5 below provides an aggregated list of transactions, withdrawals, and presidential decisions from

Withdrawal of a notice is a function of the particular facts and circumstances of the specific transaction
being reviewed by the Committee.

As shown in Table I-5, the number of notices of transactions submitted to CFIUS has fluctuated over the
last 10 years. The proportion of notices withdrawn after commencement of investigation in 2025 was
approximately 28 percent, which is an increase from 2024 (23 percent). The overall number of covered
transactions reviewed or assessed by the Committee (on the basis of a written notice or a declaration) in
2025 was 347.

A variety of factors affect the data in this Report, which may make it difficult to extrapolate CFIUS trends

### C. 対象取引、取下げ、調査の個別・累積・推移データ

表I-5は2016〜2025年の取引、取下げ、大統領決定を集計した一覧である。この10年間に、CFIUSが第721条の対象取引と判断した取引について、企業は2,263件の正式通知を提出した。このうち審査段階で取り下げられたのは1％未満（19件）だった。約56％（1,261件）が調査に進み、約24％（536件）が調査段階で取り下げられた。正式通知の取下げは、委員会が審査する個別取引の具体的な事実や事情に左右される。

表I-5が示すとおり、CFIUSに提出される正式通知件数はこの10年間に変動した。調査開始後に取り下げられた正式通知の割合は2025年が約28％で、2024年の23％から上昇した。正式通知または簡易届出に基づき委員会が審査または評価した対象取引の総件数は2025年に347件だった。

本報告のデータはさまざまな要因の影響を受けるため、CFIUSの傾向を年ごとに外挿することは難しい。CFIUSは取引を個別に検討する。取下げ、審査または調査段階での終結、大統領決定のいずれになるかは、個々の案件の事実と事情による。
